title: Chiron: Cache Management Empowered by LLM Intelligence for AI Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2611.06179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI clusters keep data in remote object stores and rely on local caches to stop GPUs from waiting for data. A cache performs well only when its prefetching and eviction policies match the access pattern, yet these patterns differ across AI workloads and change between phases of one workflow. Existing methods either need code changes, which compromises user transparency, or use low-end heuristics, which cannot follow such changes. Large language models (LLMs) can infer access behavior without user hints, but direct LLM control of cache actions suffers from long reasoning delay, high token cost, and poor decision quality. We present Chiron, a cache system based on advisory switching control. An LLM asynchronously diagnoses the access pattern and recommends a policy. A deterministic harness gates this advice, executes expert-designed policies locally, and returns cache feedback for review. We implement Chiron atop JuiceFS and evaluate it o

translated_title: Chiron：由大语言模型智能赋能的面向AI工作负载的缓存管理
translated_abstract: AI集群将数据保存在远程对象存储中，并依赖本地缓存来避免GPU因等待数据而空闲。只有当缓存的预取与淘汰策略与访问模式相匹配时，缓存才能发挥良好性能，然而这些模式在不同AI工作负载之间各不相同，并且在同一工作流的不同阶段之间也会发生变化。现有方法要么需要修改代码，从而损害了用户透明性，要么采用低端启发式方法，无法跟随这些变化。大语言模型（LLM）无需用户提示即可推断访问行为，但直接由LLM控制缓存操作存在推理延迟长、token成本高和决策质量差的问题。我们提出了Chiron，一个基于咨询式切换控制的缓存系统。LLM异步诊断访问模式并推荐策略；一个确定性框架对该建议进行把关，在本地执行专家设计的策略，并返回缓存反馈以供审查。我们在JuiceFS之上实现了Chiron并对其进行了评估。
tldr: Chiron提出了一种由LLM赋能的咨询式切换控制缓存管理方法：LLM异步诊断AI工作负载的访问模式并推荐缓存策略，由确定性框架把关建议并在本地执行专家设计的策略，从而在保持用户透明性的同时自适应地优化缓存性能。
en_tdlr: Chiron is a cache system where an LLM asynchronously diagnoses AI workload access patterns and recommends policies, while a deterministic harness gates the advice and locally executes expert-designed policies, enabling adaptive cache management without sacrificing user transparency.
